readme:
# Fusion Foundation

This is a repository which contains a port of the Foundation UI library made with React-Luau to Fusion 0.3.

The source folder (Foundation) contains the components and their stories, which can be used to view and test them. Some components may not have been converted yet, but most should be available.

UI Labs can be used to view and test the stories.

## Credits

* [@Roblox](https://github.com/Roblox/) - Foundation
* [@Roblox](https://github.com/Roblox/) - [Signal](https://github.com/Roblox/signal-lua)
* [@Roblox](https://github.com/Roblox/) - [Dash](https://github.com/Roblox/dash/)
* [@Roblox](https://github.com/Roblox/) - BuilderIcons
* [@Roblox](https://github.com/Roblox/) - FoundationImages
* [@Roblox](https://github.com/Roblox/) - FoundationCloudAssets
* [@Roblox](https://github.com/Roblox/) - RbxDesignFoundations
* [@Elttob](https://github.com/dphfox/) - [Fusion](https://github.com/dphfox/Fusion)

type StateLayerMode = StateLayerMode.StateLayerMode
type InputPlacement = InputPlacement.InputPlacement
type ColorNamespace = ColorNamespace.ColorNamespace

local MAX_LAYOUT_ORDER = 2147483648
local MIN_LAYOUT_ORDER = -2147483648
local DEFAULT_DELAY_TIME = 0.15

-- this should live in tokens
local DISABLED_TRANSPARENCY = 0.5
local SHADOW_IMAGE = "component_assets/dropshadow_17_8"
local SHADOW_SIZE = 16

local INPUT_PLACEMENT_TO_LABEL_ALIGNMENT: { [InputPlacement]: Enum.HorizontalAlignment } = {
	[InputPlacement.Start] = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right,
	[InputPlacement.End] = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left,
}

local ColorNamespaceToStateLayerMode: { [boolean]: { [ColorNamespace]: StateLayerMode } } = {
	[false] = {
		[ColorNamespace.Color] = StateLayerMode.Default,
		[ColorNamespace.Inverse] = StateLayerMode.Inverse,
		[ColorNamespace.LightMode] = StateLayerMode.Light,
		[ColorNamespace.DarkMode] = StateLayerMode.Dark,
	},
	[true] = {
		[ColorNamespace.Color] = StateLayerMode.Inverse,
		[ColorNamespace.Inverse] = StateLayerMode.Default,
		[ColorNamespace.LightMode] = StateLayerMode.Dark,
		[ColorNamespace.DarkMode] = StateLayerMode.Light,
	},
}

return {
	MAX_LAYOUT_ORDER = MAX_LAYOUT_ORDER,
	MIN_LAYOUT_ORDER = MIN_LAYOUT_ORDER,
	DISABLED_TRANSPARENCY = DISABLED_TRANSPARENCY,
	DEFAULT_DELAY_TIME = DEFAULT_DELAY_TIME,

		TRAP_FOCUS = {

local Foundation = script.Parent.Parent
local PackageManager = require(Foundation.PackageManager)

local Fusion = PackageManager.getPackage("Fusion")

local Types = require(Foundation.Utility.Types)

type UsedAs<T> = Types.UsedAs<T>
type AspectRatio = Types.AspectRatio
type AspectRatioTable = Types.AspectRatioTable

export type AspectRatioProps = {
	scope: Types.Scope,
	value: AspectRatio,
}

local function getAspectRatio(aspectRatio: AspectRatio): {
	AspectRatio: UsedAs<number>,
	AspectType: UsedAs<Enum.AspectType>?,
	DominantAxis: UsedAs<Enum.DominantAxis>?,
}
	if typeof(aspectRatio) == "table" then
		local aspectRatioTable = aspectRatio :: AspectRatioTable
		return {
			AspectRatio = aspectRatioTable.AspectRatio,
			AspectType = aspectRatioTable.AspectType,
			DominantAxis = aspectRatioTable.DominantAxis,
		}
	else
		return {
			AspectRatio = aspectRatio,
			AspectType = nil,
			DominantAxis = nil,
		}
	end
end

--[[
	Fragment is a placeholder component that can be used to render children components in the same scope
	as the main component it's been provided to. This is necessary in certain components, due to
	children components' scope outliving the main component's scope.
]]

local Foundation = script.Parent.Parent
local PackageManager = require(Foundation.PackageManager)

local Dash = PackageManager.getPackage("Dash")

local Utility = Foundation.Utility
local Types = require(Utility.Types)

type Scope = Types.Scope
type Child = Types.Child

return function(props: {{(...any) -> (any) | {[string]: any}}}, setAsKey: boolean?): (scope: Scope) -> Child
	return function(scope: Scope): Child
		local children = {}
		for i, data in props do
			local component: (...any) -> (any) = data[1]
			local componentProps: {[string]: any} = data[2]
			componentProps = Dash.union(componentProps, { scope = scope })
			
			if setAsKey then children[i] = component(componentProps); continue end
			table.insert(children, component(componentProps))
		end
		return children
	end
end

local Foundation = script.Parent.Parent
local Utility = Foundation.Utility

local isState = require(Utility.isState)
local unwrap = require(Utility.unwrap)
local Types = require(Utility.Types)

type UsedAs<T> = Types.UsedAs<T>
type Scope = Types.Scope

type Padding = Types.Padding
type PaddingTable = Types.PaddingTable

export type PaddingProps = {
	value: Padding,
	scope: Scope
}

local function getPadding(padding: Padding): {
	PaddingTop: UsedAs<UDim>?,
	PaddingBottom: UsedAs<UDim>?,
	PaddingLeft: UsedAs<UDim>?,
	PaddingRight: UsedAs<UDim>?,
}
	if isState(padding) then
		return {
			PaddingTop = padding :: UsedAs<UDim>,
			PaddingBottom = padding :: UsedAs<UDim>,
			PaddingLeft = padding :: UsedAs<UDim>,
			PaddingRight = padding :: UsedAs<UDim>,
		}
	elseif typeof(padding) == "table" then
		local paddingTable = padding :: PaddingTable
		return {
			PaddingTop = paddingTable.top,
			PaddingBottom = paddingTable.bottom,
			PaddingLeft = paddingTable.left,
			PaddingRight = paddingTable.right,
		}
	elseif typeof(padding) == "number" then
		return {
			PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, padding),
			PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, padding),
			PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, padding),
			PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, padding),
		}
	elseif typeof(padding) == "Vector2" then
		return {
			PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, padding.Y),
			PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, padding.Y),
			PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, padding.X),
			PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, padding.X),
		}
	elseif typeof(padding) == "UDim" then
		return {
			PaddingTop = padding,
			PaddingBottom = padding,
			PaddingLeft = padding,
			PaddingRight = padding,
		}
	elseif typeof(padding) == "UDim2" then
		return {
			PaddingTop = padding.Y,
			PaddingBottom = padding.Y,
			PaddingLeft = padding.X,
			PaddingRight = padding.X,
		}
	else
		return {}
	end
end

local function Padding(props: PaddingProps)
	local Scope = props.scope
	assert(Scope, "A scope has not been provided for the Padding component.")
	
	local padding = getPadding(props.value)
	return Scope:New("UIPadding")(padding)
end

return Padding
